mirror.endpoint.label: Mirror Endpoint
mirror.endpoint.help: Final Beam receiver URL, e.g. https://team.example.com/api/v1/beam/sessions. Redirects are not followed; retries pause until the service restarts or the endpoint changes.

mirror.token.label: Mirror Token
mirror.token.help: Gateway credential for the remote receiver, sent as a Bearer token.

recommendedPrompts: Explain how Beam can let a team view a sanitized coding-session snapshot and create an independent continuation from it. Give me a concise setup and privacy checklist, including what the receiver can and cannot access. This is an explanation only: do not enable Beam, upload a transcript, or transfer anything.

Compare Beam snapshots with Session Share for a team that wants read-only visibility into work. Explain their source types, audience controls, redaction limits, and continuation behavior so I can choose deliberately. Do not read or share any sessions, configure either plugin, or perform a handoff.
